facts.value: The option does not include the study of a language.
Students who meet additional language requirements could elect to study one BBS with Modern Language programmes.
Students wishing to take a language option must have a H4 in that language, with the exception of Japanese or Beginners Spanish where a H4 in a language other than English is required.
BBS with French includes the French language stream throughout the four years of the programme.
BBS with German includes the German language stream throughout the four years of the programme.
BBS with Japanese includes the Japanese language stream throughout the four years of the programme.
BBS with Spanish (Beginners or Advanced) includes the Spanish language stream throughout the four years of the programme.
